description: Consorzi di Miglioramento Fondiario: Consorzi irrigui is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by mappe.regione.vda.it. Irrigation channels managed by the various land improvement consortia. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Consortia for land improvement: Irrigation consortia" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2026-03-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
